newsitem.title: USA: Physicians' Specialty loses Aetna contract.
newsitem.headline: Physicians' Specialty loses Aetna contract.

text.p: Physicians' Specialty Corp said Friday that Aetna Health Plans of Georgia Inc, a unit of Aetna Inc is modifying its delivery system of ENT Services in the Atlanta market.
As part of this modification, the company said Aetna is terminating its capitated ENT managed care contract with it effective June 30.

Aetna, said the company, has advised it that its affiliated physicians can continue to provide services to Aetna enrollees subsequent to June 30th upon execution of new physician provider agreements, and Physicians' Specialty expects that these new provider agreements will reimburse physicians on a modified fee-for-service basis.
The company said it does not believe the Aetna contract termination will have a material adverse effect on its business, financial condition or results of operations.
